body:
Elaine H: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still need explicit owners and ETA for the customer-facing pieces. Who will take the status page blurb, the short incident summary, and the policy for sharing the full report?
Samir R: I can draft the external summary and status page copy. prefer to mirror the tone we used last quarter. ETA: EOD Thu? :calendar:
Grace L: Support will pull the impacted customer list. Want confirmation on whether we send the short summary to everyone or only to affected accounts first.
Paul M: For the short summary, keep it non-technical. If customers ask for a deep-dive, we can offer a sanitized RCA + a path to request the full technical appendix.
Jon S: Prioritize high-commitment customers (contracted SLAs) for early notification. I can push a tailored note once Samir has a draft.
Maya K: Agreed with Jon. Also want to include recommended mitigations (if any) for customers to implement. That should be a separate bullet in the summary.
Samir R: Noted. Question for Legal: do we allow full RCAs to be shared on request, or only under NDA / enterprise channel?
Legal Team: Short answer — external summary (sanitized) is fine to publish. Full, unredacted RCAs that include logs or customer identifiers require review; prefer to gate on an email request and case-by-case review. If a customer requests internal logs we need signed data-sharing agreement first.
Elaine H: Thanks. So action items: Samir -> draft public summary + status page copy by EOD Thu. Grace -> impacted-list by tomorrow noon. Jon -> prioritize outreach to SLA customers after draft. Legal -> provide redaction checklist and required language by tomorrow COB.
Paul M: For the redaction checklist, suggest items: remove customer-identifying IPs, truncate stack traces, redact any raw keys. Also add a line: "For customers who need deeper technical details, contact support with proof of authorization."
Samir R: Will follow that checklist. Draft will include a short timeline, impact statement, and what we fixed. I'll add a "how to ask for more" section linking to support form.
Maya K: Can we include a one-sentence statement about mitigations we pushed (e.g., "scaled routing policy and hotfix deployed") without code details?
Paul M: Yes — mention the mitigation and that a permanent fix is in progress, owners are assigned. Avoid commit IDs or exact deploy diffs.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 closed by @paulm at 2026-03-22T18:02:13Z :white_check_mark:
Elaine H: Small timeline decision: Do we publish the status page update immediately (short note) and then follow up with the full sanitized incident summary once Legal signs off, or wait and release both together? Thoughts?
Jon S: Publish the short status page now (2-3 lines) — customers expect visibility. Then surface the longer summary within 48h after legal redaction pass. :+1:
Legal Team: Confirmed. Short status update OK now. We will aim to deliver redaction guidance within 24 hours.
Grace L: I'll flag the accounts list as high/medium/low impact so outreach cadence is clear.
Samir R: Draft posted to #incidents-drafts in 30m for review. Ping me for quick edits.
Elaine H: Great. Owners and timeline captured. I'll add these to the incident action tracker and follow up on Wednesday check-in. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
